name: Alcanó (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with a yellow culverin lying horizontally with its mouth towards the hoist.
history: The official flag of Alcanó is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with the yellow culverin of the arms, 1/4 of the height and 15/24 of the length of the cloth, placed horizontally with its mouth towards the hoist, at the centre; the arms were approved on 17 August 1993 and the flag on 7 March 2006, published in the DOGC on 23 March 2006.

features.role: culverin (cannon) lying horizontally with its mouth towards the hoist
